name: Shell
about: In Gode’s editor, you can complete code, see errors and warnings as you type, inspect hover information, go to definitions, find references and rename symbols in shell scripts. The language server starts when a shell script opens in a project and stops when none are open. When ShellCheck is on your PATH, the server uses it for richer diagnostics.
ready: Ready to assist with shell scripts.
